title: Spending program, revenue code top agenda in first BARMM Cabinet meeting

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The preparation of the 2027 expenditure program as well as refinements in a proposed revenue code for the region topped the agenda of the first meeting of the Bangsamoro Cabinet on Friday. Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua presided over the meeting, reminding that “the success of the regular Bangsamoro Government would be measured not only by the milestones it achieves but, more importantly, by the positive changes it brings to the lives of the people it serves.” READ: BARMM chief forms Cabinet The Cabinet discussed the administration’s priorities for its first 100 days in office as well as outlined […]...
